- Material drop: stop operation, assess status, re-grasp if safe, otherwise report and await instructions
- Path obstructed: decelerate or stop, re-identify environment, plan alternative path, or pause and report
- SOP discrepancy with site: stop and report if SOP does not match actual environment

This Standard Operating Procedure is intended to guide operators or automated handling equipment to complete material handling tasks in an electronics factory according to unified requirements. By standardizing the execution process, it ensures that the material handling process from the starting point to the end point meets the following requirements:
Safe and controllable
Reasonable path
Accurate grasping
Stable placement
Traceable anomalies
